subject: Subset dataframe based on user input and save result for further use

messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Subset dataframe based on user input and save result for further use
parts:
Hi,

My df seems like this:

name year sex n prop city1 city2 city3 ....



I need to input name in some  text input control and subset data as

year city1 city2 city 3

The resulting dataframe I will reshape from wide form to long form for further visualization as:

year city n

How can I save all this changed dataframes in background so I can use them step by step?

Regards

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Subset dataframe based on user input and save result for further use
parts:
I'm not sure what you mean by "use them step by step" but the idiomatic way to do this, if you need to access the intermediate values, is to use a different reactive for each step.

df <- ...

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  subsetted <- reactive({
    validate(need(input$columns, "Please choose some columns"))
    df[,input$columns]
  })
  reshaped <- reactive({
    melt(subsetted(), ...)  # or whatever
  })
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot2(reshaped(), ...)  # or whatever
  })
})
